scope: Static production call-path proof that clinical signing and affirmation commands do not enter PEM or shared sync replay
command: python3 inline source-boundary check over production web TypeScript

mechanism.affirmation: useSurgeonGate -> gateApi -> httpClient POST; command ID is retained locally only for explicit server receipt lookup.
mechanism.signing: No production web signing mutation caller exists; server and inactive desktop operations call AppServices directly and expose no PEM port.
mechanism.reassessment: useEvidenceTimeline reads PGlite but sends reassessment and lookup through timelineApi HTTP; it does not write the local database or graph.
mechanism.shared_sync: Production shared sync sources contain none of the signing, gate-mutation or reassessment command contracts/routes.

unverified: A future source change could add a new command caller; task 8 must revalidate this boundary against the final artifact.
